name: skill-library-pruner
title_zh: 先盘点再动手，删技能前会问你三遍的整理师
tagline_zh: 技能库长到 200 个、一半没碰过？它先列清单标出从未使用的，再逐个禁用试运行。
tagline_en: Skills piled up, half unused? It inventories, flags never-used, disables safely, then deletes only what you.
desc_en: Read-first, reversible workflow for pruning an overgrown Claude Code skills library. Inventories every skill, spots duplicates and dead weight, reports what has not been used, disables safely, then deletes only what goes unmissed. Use when the user wants to prune, declutter, audit, consolidate, or shrink their skills, or says "I have too many skills", "clean up my skills", "which of my skills are
why_zh: 别人直接删，它先禁用一周。用「未使用时长」排序而非文件名，逼你面对真实习惯，而不是凭印象砍错宝贝。
why_en: Others delete outright; it disables first. Ranks by last-used date, not filename, forcing honest pruning instead of gut-feel.
limit_zh: 只处理 Claude Code 的 skills 目录，不碰插件或全局配置；需要你手动确认每个禁用项，不能无人值守。
limit_en: Only prunes Claude Code's skills dir, not plugins or global config; requires manual confirmation per disable—no unattended mode; deleted skills.
title_en: Inventory-first skill pruner that asks thrice before.
